_about: Public-domain Henry Hammond (1605-1660, Caroline divine, chaplain to Charles I, 'father of English biblical criticism') for the Word Hoard: A Paraphrase and Annotations upon the New Testament (4 vols, Oxford 1845), A Practical Catechism (Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology, 1847) and the Miscellaneous Theological Works (Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology, 3 vols, 1847-50, vol. 3 being the Thirty-one Sermons), raw Internet Archive OCR. Greek in the Paraphrase's text layer, measured 2026-10-03: vols. 2 and 4 carry it (36,496 and 163,028 Greek characters); vols. 1 and 3 have 0, so their Greek quotations are lost in OCR. No 1845 copy on IA with Greek in vols. 1 or 3 was found. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 13 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
